product_overview: Telegram bot UI layer — all data via backend API, no direct DB access

general_info.name: Product Creation & Discovery
general_info.overview: Bot widgets for creating products and conducting discovery interview via Telegram

goal_and_context.business_goal: Provide Telegram UI for product creation and discovery flow
goal_and_context.user_problem: User needs a simple conversational interface to describe product ideas

business_rules.description: Bot must not access database directly
All data operations go through backend HTTP API
Idea text must be at least 10 characters

acceptance_criteria.user_story: As a Telegram user, I want to tap 'Create Product' and describe my idea

bdd.given: User is in the main menu
bdd.when: User taps Create Product and enters idea text
bdd.then: Bot calls backend API and shows first discovery question

acceptance_criteria.user_story: As a Telegram user, I want to answer discovery questions until complete

bdd.then: Bot shows next question or marks discovery complete

non_functional_requirements.description: Bot = UI only, no DB access
Bot must handle errors gracefully with user-friendly messages

test_cases.assertion: Returns correct answer_name based on input

input.text: A Telegram bot for fitness tracking with daily workouts

test_cases.assertion: base_url starts with http and no trailing slash

general_info.name: Feature Actions
general_info.overview: Telegram inline keyboard actions for feature-level PRD workflow steps

goal_and_context.business_goal: Provide step-by-step Telegram UI for the full PRD-to-code pipeline
goal_and_context.user_problem: User needs guided actions for each stage of feature development

business_rules.description: Each action button maps to a backend API call
Feature actions are shown as inline keyboard buttons

acceptance_criteria.user_story: As a Telegram user, I want to tap action buttons to progress through PRD workflow

bdd.when: User taps an action button (e.g., Generate PRD Draft)
bdd.then: Bot calls backend API and shows result

non_functional_requirements.description: Long text responses must be truncated to 4000 chars (Telegram limit)

test_cases.setup: Mock callback query and API client
test_cases.assertion: Backend API called and response shown
